Add a CPU-controlled snake mode that automatically searches for food. Add the three game modes: human vs human, cpu vs human, cpu vs cpu. Display the score during gameplay. Include a start menu and game over screen. Allow restarting the game with a keypress. Use file name "snake_openai-gpt-6.1-sol_01.html"

toolCallDetails.arguments: {"path":"snake_openai-gpt-6.1-sol_01.html","edit_description":"Create a complete self-contained HTML file with inline CSS and JavaScript, no dependencies/assets/network. A polished dark neon classic two-player Snake arena on precisely 30x30 canvas grid. Responsive layout, clear headings, score cards for mint Player 1 and violet Player 2, grid canvas, instructions. Start menu overlay with three selectable modes Human vs Human, CPU vs Human, CPU vs CPU and Start button. Human vs Human: P1 WASD P2 arrow keys; CPU vs Human: P1 CPU P2 human arrows; CPU vs CPU both AI. Display role labels and per-snake score (10 points per food), mode during gameplay. Game over overlay with winner or draw, reason, final scores, Play Again and menu button. R restarts current mode including game over, Enter starts menu/restarts game over, Escape returns menu, P pauses/resumes with visible overlay. Controls text always clear. Continuous fixed timestep movement approx 130ms via requestAnimationFrame accumulator (cap elapsed), use canvas intrinsic 600x600 20px cells, responsive CSS. Start snakes length 4 facing each other at separated y rows in open space. One shared random food spawned strictly on empty cells; growth when eaten. Simultaneous tick: gather input/AI directions then proposed heads, growth flags, collision evaluate walls, bodies of both snakes excluding tails only when their owner not growing that tick, same target head and head swaps both crash; calculate all crashes before committing moves; any crash ends round immediately, other snake wins or simultaneous crashes draw. Food respawn after growth; full board ends with score-based winner. Prevent reverse turns and multiple human turn changes causing reversal within a tick by a single pending direction accepted relative to committed direction (first valid turn until next tick); prevent default arrows/space for controls. AI genuinely searches food each tick using BFS through available non-body cells (exclude tails that can move conservatively, avoid enemy immediate possible next cells if possible), reconstruct first direction, never choose reverse. If no safe route, select valid neighboring moves maximizing reachable free area by flood fill with distance to food tie break, avoid walls/self/opponent; deterministic but useful AI. AI may lose legitimately, no teleport or cheating. Rendering attractive crisp subtle grid, rounded body segments, brighter head with directional eyes, glowing food, accessible buttons and focus styles, reduced-motion CSS, readable score typography, mobile responsive page (keyboard game explicitly noted). Canvas aria-label and fallback text; overlay semantics accessible. Initial board preview visible behind menu but no movement before start. Initialize everything safely with clear English functions and concise comments for simultaneous collision and BFS. Implement all requested functionality completely in this file."}
